messages.呼吸回数を貯めてから、加重値の上がったS2「応接道第七式 捕捉」で複数の敵をまと: A Slash attacker that builds Poise Count, then cuts through multiple enemies with increased-Attack-Weight S2 Receiving Arts 7: Capture. Critical hits against enemies marked with B.M. can deal greatly increased critical damage based on the Speed difference.
messages.S2の加重値増加: 戦闘開始時に呼吸回数6を消耗して加重値+2。Ⅰコイン的中時に: **S2's Attack Weight increase**: At Combat Start, spends 6 Poise Count for +2 Attack Weight. On Coin Ⅰ hit, gains 2/3 Poise and inflicts 1 B.M. on Critical Hit. Coin Ⅱ inflicts 2 B.M. on hit. If it hits multiple enemies, the effects apply to each one.
messages.呼吸回数の準備: S1「応接道一式 狩り」は使用時とⅠコイン的中時に呼吸回数が2: **Preparing Poise Count**: S1 Receiving Arts 1: The Hunt increases Poise Count by 2 on use and again on Coin Ⅰ hit, and Coin Ⅱ inflicts 2 B.M. S3 Receiving Arts 2: S.Y.N.C. increases Poise Count by 7 on use and grants 5 Poise on Coin Ⅰ hit.
messages.バトルパッシブ「家事の仕上げ」(傲慢×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): バ・目の対象: **Combat passive — Clearing Household Chores (3 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Hitting a target with B.M. grants 1 Poise Count and 1 Haste next turn, up to 3 times per turn. A Critical Hit against a target with B.M. removes B.M. and grants +5/10% Critical damage per point of Speed difference, up to 30/60%.
messages.速度差で強化: 対象の速度が自分より低いと、S1・S2はマッチ威力、S3はコイン: **Speed-difference bonuses**: If the target is slower than her, S1 and S2 gain Clash Power and S3 gains Coin Power. The base rule is +1 per 2 Speed difference (up to 3 for S2 and 2 for S3). For S1, it is +1 at a difference of 3 or more at lower Uptie, and +1 per 2 difference, up to 3, at higher Uptie.
messages.S3: Ⅰコインで次のターンに束縛1を付与し、ダメージ量の20/30%だけ混乱区: **S3**: Coin Ⅰ inflicts 1 Bind next turn and shifts the Stagger Threshold by 20/30% of the damage dealt. Coin Ⅱ gains +20/40% Critical damage against staggered targets. Defeating an enemy with Coin Ⅱ reuses the skill once on a random enemy with B.M. (this does not trigger on the reuse, and fizzles if no enemy has B.M.).
messages.序盤はS1・S3で呼吸回数と呼吸を貯める。S2を使うのは呼吸回数を8〜9ほど貯め: Early on, build Poise Count and Poise with S1 and S3. It is safest to use S2 after building about 8–9 Poise Count. Cut through multiple enemies with S2 and land Coin Ⅱ on the B.M. applied by Coin Ⅰ's Critical Hit to trigger the passive. Throw S3 at enemies she can likely defeat and chain into reuse against enemies with B.M. Her attacks are all Slash, so she struggles against enemies that resist Slash. Against single bosses, her multi-target attacks and reuse are hard to make use of.
